title: Traveller roaming bundles (synthetic)
text:
The synthetic GCT Traveller 10 bundle covers 42 European countries. It includes 10 GB of roaming data, 100 outgoing minutes at 0.25 AED per extra minute and unlimited incoming SMS.

The bundle is valid for 30 days and costs 99 AED. Unused data does not roll over.

title: Traveller roaming bundles (synthetic)
text: In Asia the synthetic Traveller 10 bundle covers 18 countries with 6 GB of roaming data and 60 outgoing minutes at 0.40 AED per extra minute. It costs 129 AED for 30 days.

title: Prepaid Plus tariff (synthetic)
text: Synthetic GCT Prepaid Plus costs 55 AED per month. From October 2026 a 15 AED digital services fee applies to plans with streaming add-ons, which explains most bill increases of 15 AED.

title: Enterprise roaming discount approval (synthetic)
text: A synthetic enterprise roaming bundle discount up to 10 percent is approved by the account manager. Discounts from 10 to 25 percent need the regional sales director. Discounts above 25 percent need the commercial committee, which meets every Tuesday.

title: Q3 network capex board pack (synthetic)
text: Synthetic Q3 network capex is 412.6 million AED, of which 61 percent is 5G radio.

title: Retired summer roaming promotion (synthetic)
text: The retired synthetic summer roaming promotion gave 5 GB of Europe roaming data for 49 AED.

title: Escalation examples (synthetic)
text: Escalate roaming billing disputes older than 60 days to the billing team.

title: Escalation examples (synthetic)
text: Example customer +971 50 123 4567 disputed a Europe roaming charge.

title: Microwave link alarm runbook (synthetic)
text: For a synthetic microwave link-down alarm, check the far-end site power first, then the radio unit. Escalate after 15 minutes if both are healthy.
